## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Feb 18, 2026 - Aug 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mmmccc888_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve used the Forest app for over a decade, and even purchased the paid version, in which time I’ve gotten tens of friends to join and have used it religiously throughout college, grad school applications, and entering the workforce. I loved this app. I’m incredibly disappointed in the direction the app has gone, pushing a bigger and more expensive paid option and updating the UI in a way that is glitchy, lags, and no longer tracks time accurately. When I focus longer than the set time, despite having my settings to track extended time, it doesn’t record it. The app also crashes at least once a week or takes 30s-1 min just to switch pages. I’m also sick of having Plus pushed onto me - I have already paid for Forest previously and don’t want my app to continue trying to sell me stuff. This is also not even to mention that I can no longer plant trees in real life or make any kind of real world impact. I will stop using Forest if the glitches and over commercialization do not get fixed."
            2. _Noor_75_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "Most of us bought the app to have it forever. Now they’re hitting us with the premium suscription, and now ADS???? yall became so greedy"
            3. _kpiekut_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "So I have spent some time over the years using the app on and off, unlocked some bits, decided to focus again only to be met with a sub paywall and all of my progress lost."
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Review examples:**
            1. _I just wanna read da Bible_, Jul 13, 2026, 3/5: "I really love this app (that I bought years ago), and as a graduate student I used to use it frequently. Recently, I needed a way to re-balance my time, and thought to re-download. Now it’s loaded with tons of ads and requests to purchase premium. It still works, but it’s a bit much and is irksome to use especially considering I paid for it (eg unskippable ad after most sessions?)"
